items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew of him. I didn’t – I met him once.

ctx.x: Morris Goldenberg? Do you know him?
I knew of him. I didn’t – I met him once. I’m not too familiar – I’m familiar with his work, and his students all came out – didn’t Joe Morello study with him?
Yeah. He taught a lot of folks.
